title: Contact Rigidity and Comparison Kernels for Type A lci Schubert Varieties
summary: Let $X_w$ be a Type A local complete intersection Schubert variety. We prove Contact Rigidity: the existence of two smooth singular components forces some pair of singular components to contain a common Schubert subvariety of codimension one in each. If the singular locus is a single smooth component $X_z$, the rational comparison kernel is $IC_z$, and $P_{u,w}(q)=1+q^{(\ell(w)-\ell(z)-1)/2}$ for every $u\leq z$.
